description: This file contains setup operations for a company's configuration in an ERP system, including creating fiscal years, companies, email digests, logos, and website setup.

methods.name: create_fiscal_year_and_company
methods.description: Creates fiscal year and company records based on provided arguments.

methods.name: enable_shopping_cart
methods.description: Enables shopping cart settings for a specified company.

methods.name: create_email_digest
methods.description: Creates weekly and scheduler error email digests for system managers.

methods.name: create_logo
methods.description: Uploads and sets a company logo in website settings.

methods.name: create_website
methods.description: Calls website_maker to set up website configuration.

methods.name: get_fy_details
methods.description: Generates fiscal year string based on start and end dates.
